objective: Keep the old serving deployment on duty throughout slow or failed immutable image pull and initialization; never admit a candidate before both completion checks succeed.

configuration.host: Local file in isolated headless Microsoft Edge

preconditions: Healthy GA and sufficient overlap capacity are assumed, not measured.
A compatible immutable candidate and successful in-budget synthetic requests are fixtures.
Pull and initialization completion evidence are sequential and both required.
expectedAssertions: Old GA serves all ticks before successful initialization and the selected handoff.
Waiting, missing observations, failed pull and failed initialization keep candidate admissions at zero.
A ready candidate receives only three final-tick synthetic admissions.
Prediction correctness is independent from candidate outcome and cannot force admission.
Invalid input or state and a ninth run are rejected without mutating retained evidence.

verifier.scope: Local model consistency, actual DOM/keyboard/error/reset/failure/CSP behavior; not native validation.

tooling.helperLifecycleLimit: Not a fully qualified unattended runner; abandoned recovery prototype is unqualified.

userImpact: UNMEASURED for real users. All traffic and completion checks are synthetic. Candidate failures do not invent GA interruptions.
cleanup: Awaited isolated browser close in finally; session history is memory-only and resettable.
publication: Implementation commit and annotated kanban/A-S026/<12sha> marker are resolved by the authorized publisher; no self-referential commit hash is invented.
acceptance: Parent-owned independent review required; this worker cannot award Done.

nativeRemainder.blocker: CORE, DATA and IMAGEHOST gates, approved target/access and immutable-image/startup fixtures, and separate native execution authority are outstanding.

limits: No native Azure, real container, production Node24 or source-parent certification.
No IaC, cloud resources, identity, scaffold, deployment, expenditure, packages or browser downloads.
Ordinary verification preserves proof; CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 is deliberate append-only capture.
One frozen satisfier unit; tests, refinements and repeated checks earn no extra credit.
